review: Natural-limb continuation, mental compartments, contacts and protection modifiers inventoried. Layer interactions, hidden-information contracts, modifier compatibility and independent validation remain pending.

entries.acceptance: Eight-point natural blades convert punch/kick to cutting or impaling chosen before attack. Eleven-point larger version also adds one per damage die. Reuse limb occupancy and attack profiles, preserving earlier variants.

Five-point recognized religious office grants ceremonial authority, reaction+1 from followers/respectful audience and institution rank zero. Higher rank purchased separately; office grants no supernatural power.

Twenty-point surface adhesion allows wall/ceiling travel at half basic movement and stationary attachment without climbing check on eligible surfaces. Falling catch needs reachable surface, dexterity contact then strength at -1 per five yards fallen, scaled for gravity. Failed arrest subtracts five fall yards; clarify missed-contact versus failed-strength consequence.

Specific-surface limitation costs -40% common, -60% uncommon, -80% exceptionally rare. Author defines actual material predicate before action; category does not imply all surfaces of similar appearance.

Fifteen-point reflex trait adds one active defense/quick draw, two fear resistance, six intelligence waking/surprise/mental-stun recovery and prevents freezing. Group initiative+1 or+2 if leader. Advanced time perception includes it; reject double purchase/bonus.

Ten-point judgment aid prompts hidden intelligence check when author identifies an ill-advised action. Success warns before commitment. Define warning timing and information without overriding player choice or revealing unrelated secrets.

Fifty points per level adds one mental maneuver but no additional physical task. Compartments share underlying mental capabilities yet receive hypnosis/powers independently. Track ongoing concentration per compartment without duplicating whole-character resources.

External influence over one compartment can contest will for body control; current controller+1. Compartments may use mental abilities on each other with actual intelligence/will/protection, retaining independent effects and common body.

General operator station costs25 per level, dedicated task station10. Operators use own maneuvers through vehicle capabilities, respecting ready weapons and physical limits. Intelligence-zero vehicle depends on operators; conflicting orders compare control skills.

Fifteen-point constriction needs prior grapple of victim no larger than self. On subsequent turns strength versus higher victim strength/health deals victory-margin damage; integrate damage type, armor and restraint rules from combat references.

Contact group specifies one organization or one locality/social stratum and an appropriate knowledge category. Cost five times individually calculated contact cost; broader groups unsupported. Effective category check is abstract information access, not an interchangeable trained skill.

Contact grants knowledge within approved skill/background or minor favor meeting at least two of quick, inexpensive and nonhazardous. Author defines facts available, channels, requested favor and price; cannot invent knowledge outside scope.

Base effective skill12/15/18/21 costs1/2/3/4; supernatural information access adds one. Apply appearance then reliability modifiers and group multiplier with specified rounding. Effective information score differs from NPC actual skills.

Roll availability on attempted contact, not only adventure start: failure blocks that day, raw17/18 blocks whole adventure. Closed communication channel prevents attempt regardless of purchased frequency. Shared contact can be reached at most once per day across all player owners.

On availability success, hidden effective-skill check per declared question/favor. First full skill, later cumulative -2 within that contact session; retain order and prevent reopening to reset penalties.
Fully reliable multiplier3: ordinary failure yields information after1d days, critical failure only ignorance. Own pending research/delivery so repeated requests cannot accelerate it.
Usually reliable multiplier2: critical failure lies; ordinary failure permits another skill check after1d days, whose failure ends research. Prevent unlimited retry chain.

Somewhat reliable multiplier1: ordinary failure cannot answer; critical failure lies, raw18 also alerts relevant opposition/authority. Persist fictional notification as world event, not external real messaging.

Unreliable multiplier one half rounded up, final price at least one; effective skill-2. Any failure lies and critical failure alerts opposition. Hidden knowledge must not leak via public outcome metadata.

Appropriate cash/favors raise reliability through usually reliable only; further increments raise effective skill. Indicative daily/weekly/monthly/annual income gives+1/+2/+3/+4. Resolve already-fully-reliable case explicitly. Actual favors require authored obligations/actions, not free bonuses.
New justified contact can be purchased or awarded instead of advancement points. Use one event identity and do not both grant relationship value and duplicate award currency.
Cinematic cultural adaptation costs ten for own-species cultures, twenty for all world cultures; removes unfamiliarity-3 within scope. Does not teach languages or create social permissions.
entries.validation_note: Typed 10/20-point coverage, explicit cinematic campaign choice, species/world facts and active/mitigated cultural penalty integration implemented. Template copy and selection preserve ownership. Ancestry transformations and automatic designation of every cultural task remain pending. Fixtures authored, unrun.

entries.acceptance: Cybernetic capability is purchased through its actual trait definitions. Electrical/maintenance temporary disadvantages can apply only to implant, not whole character. Preserve component fault scope during suppression and repair.

Natural protection costs five per level, after worn armor and before wound factor; excludes eyes/windows and mental attacks by default. Ordinary humans ineligible; ordinary natural armor capped1–5, other eligible beings author-approved. Track actual layer and location coverage.

Damage-limited defense uses direct cause, not remote causal history: source-origin restriction protects direct component only. Author defines predicate and rarity before price; unsupported meaningless categories rejected.

Absorption stores one temporary character point per damage stopped up to armor-level capacity, continues stopping damage when full. Cannot absorb own strength/attack effects; may enhance nonskill traits with fixed allocation or heal. Stored/spent points decay one per second, unused first; preserve enhancement removal ordering.

Two absorbed points restore one missing health; three restore one fatigue. Genuine restoration persists, temporary excess decays. Single designated trait or healing-only enhancement+80%; unrestricted trait enhancement+100%. These are not spendable advancement awards.

Projected protection+20% covers eyes and carried items, before worn armor. Touch effect requires carrier penetration. Reject combination with skin-limited protection; do not duplicate carried-item armor against the same hit.
Each +20% hardening level moves incoming armor divisor one step through ignore,100,10,5,3,2,1. Apply to the specific hardened layer, not every armor source.

Reflection+100% returns stopped direct-hit damage; remaining damage affects defender. First reflected attack denies attacker active defense, later reflections permit ordinary defenses. Excludes area/blast/fragments/gas, incompatible with absorption. Define encounter/history scope and reflection-loop termination explicitly.
Ablative -80% loses one armor per basic damage stopped, recovering at health-healing rate including regeneration. Keep armor recovery separate from health restoration and layer original capacity.

Semi-ablative -20% loses one armor per full ten basic damage from a strike regardless penetration, recovers as ablative, and cannot combine with it. Resolve sub-ten carryover policy from exact wording; do not assume cumulative fractions.
Inability/unwillingness to wear body armor or clothing is -40%; enforce actual equipment eligibility rather than a price-only limitation.
Front-only protection -20%, each other single side/back/top/underside -40%; humanoids restricted to front/back. Use actual attack direction including area exposure.

Flexible -20% allows blunt-trauma consequences. Skin-limited -40% includes flexibility and cannot buy both; scratch/contact effects bypass natural skin protection when carrier passes worn armor even at zero damage. Reject skin plus projected-field combination.

Partial coverage discount ten percent per location attack-penalty magnitude, torso exception -10% including vitals. Limb-type coverage includes all matching limbs; single-limb doubles discount. For differing limb penalties use least severe. Validate anatomy and generic limitation floor.

Declare protection layers outermost to innermost at creation and keep order fixed. Each layer may have separate modifiers, depletion and recovery. Do not flatten to a scalar when effects depend on ordering.

Fifteen-point danger warning makes one secret perception check per hazard situation. Success warns enough to act, raw3/4 adds nature detail. Included in foresight trait, so reject duplicate purchase. Psychic-sensory membership limitation -10% adds actual interference.
Fifteen-point risk affinity adds one to skills and permits critical-failure reroll during author-approved unnecessary risk. Declare risk context before result and preserve reroll use/selection rules.

Twenty-five-point darkness sight removes darkness penalties regardless origin but no color information in darkness. Color extension+20% restores that channel; does not bypass solid cover or unrelated sensory limitations.
